orchestration_model.key_point: Actor Twin is the decision authority, not the worker. It decides what should happen, delegates execution to Knowledge Fabric Agent or Agentic Butler, then reviews and shapes the returned result before responding to the user.
orchestration_model.target_pattern: Actor Twin workflow calls Knowledge Fabric Agent and Agentic Butler workflows directly through n8n HTTP Request or Execute Workflow nodes.
orchestration_model.production_hardening_later: Move delegation through backend proxy endpoints after hosted secret storage, durable trace persistence, and approval resume are active.

cockpit_indicators.label: Backend orchestration hardening
cockpit_indicators.detail: Backend proxy orchestration remains the later production-hardening step.

required_steps: Actor Twin AI Agent generates route_decision.
If retrieve_knowledge or ingest_or_stage_knowledge, call Knowledge Fabric Agent workflow directly.
If activate_skill or create_skill, call Agentic Butler workflow directly.
Return final Actor Twin response/status to frontend.
next_actions: Apply the direct-orchestrator blueprint to the live Actor Twin workflow.
Set N8N_KNOWLEDGE_FABRIC_WEBHOOK_URL and N8N_AGENTIC_BUTLER_WEBHOOK_URL in the n8n runtime environment.
Run live UAT for answer_direct, retrieve_knowledge, ingest_or_stage_knowledge, activate_skill, create_skill, and clarification routes.
Capture full actor-to-delegate trace chains in the Review/Traces cockpit.
Move delegation to backend proxy after hosted secret storage and durable persistence are active.
